title: SkinPen® Microneedling
intro: SkinPen® microneedling is an FDA-cleared, minimally invasive treatment.

sections.heading: How It Works
paragraphs: SkinPen uses precise, controlled micro-injuries to trigger the skin's natural wound-healing response. This process stimulates new collagen and elastin production — the essential building blocks for smoother, healthier-looking skin.

sections.heading: Benefits of SkinPen® Microneedling
list: Reduces acne scars and surgical scars

sections.heading: What to Expect
paragraphs: Treatments are quick — typically 30–45 minutes — with minimal downtime. Mild redness similar to a light sunburn may occur for 24–48 hours. A series of treatments is often recommended for optimal results.

sections.heading: Why Patients Choose SkinPen®
list: Stimulates natural collagen — no fillers required
Long-lasting results with proper skincare maintenance
paragraphs: SkinPen® doesn't just treat the surface — it activates your skin's natural regenerative process, helping you achieve smoother, firmer, and more youthful-looking skin from within.
